rows.proof:
The FY2014 capital project funds. THE PAGE IS ROTATED AND MIRRORED in its own text layer -- the words read backwards and what scans as a row at constant y is a COLUMN of the table -- so each word is reversed, x is flipped, and the table is transposed before anything is read. No image was involved; the page carries its own words.
Two identities, both closing: every project returns its appropriated/forward less what was expended, encumbered or transferred as its balance, 44 of 44 that print all three; and all three columns sum to the printed Grand Total -- 74,313,023.41 / 12,873,476.33 / 61,439,547.08. The single 3084 STM Construct Middle School/High School project is 72,975,321.00 of the 74,313,023.41.

rows.proof: TRUST FUNDS FISCAL YEAR 2014 SUMMARY REPORT, pages 37 and 38 of the FY2014 annual town report. The text layer is written VERTICALLY and MIRRORED -- every word's characters come out backwards -- so each word is reversed, x is flipped (W - x1), and the page TRANSPOSES: a constant-y band is a table COLUMN. 45 funds in seven groups, nine printed columns. Every one of the page's own assertions closes: the six components sum to ENDING CASH VALUE for 45 of 45 funds; ENDING CASH VALUE + UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS = ENDING MARKET VALUE for 45 of 45; each of the six group SUBTOTALS foots its own funds across all nine columns; and the 45 funds foot to the printed GRAND TOTALS across all nine columns. TWO TOKENS ARRIVE GLUED and are split here. On the grand-total rows one word carries two figures, '($7,367.79)$2,503,900.36' and '($7,367.79)$2,247,497.89' -- TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS and ENDING CASH VALUE run together. And the ZONING INCENTIVE STABILIZATION row prints its fund name over its beginning principal, so the text layer holds ')0H9T.1R2O8N,6K2N2$AB': the letters spell BANKNORTH and the rest is $226,821.90. Neither split is asserted -- a wrong one cannot make the grand totals foot, and the $226,821.90 was afterwards read off the rendered page by eye. The MISCELLANEOUS FUNDS subtotal row is labelled in the document with a single period, not the word SUBTOTALS; it is recorded as the document prints it. The page prints a SECOND GRAND TOTALS row covering only the six grouped blocks and excluding TRUST FUNDS HELD BY OTHER BANKS; it foots across all nine columns too and is carried here as a line rather than as the page's total.
